newsitem.title: USA: Metromedia files shelf for 2.5 mln pfd.
newsitem.headline: Metromedia files shelf for 2.5 mln pfd.

text.p: Metromedia International Group Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration for up to 2.5 million shares of cumulative convertible preferred stock with a liquidation preference of $50 a share.

Underwriters for the offering are Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp; Goldman, Sachs & Co; and BT Securities Corp. They have been granted an over-allotment option to purchase up to 375,000 additional shares.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to fund the continued development of the company's systems in Eastern Europe and other emerging markets and for other general corporate needs.
